generalSituation: A dry northeast monsoon is bringing generally fine weather to Guangdong. Locally, the relative humidity over many places fell to 60 per cent or below around noon.
tcInfo: At noon, Super Typhoon Champi was centred about 640 kilometres southeast of Taibei. It is forecast to move northwest at about 14 kilometres per hour towards the seas east of Taiwan.
forecastPeriod: Weather forecast for this afternoon and tonight
forecastDesc: Mainly fine and dry. Hot in the afternoon. Moderate northerly winds, fresh offshore and on high ground at first.
outlook: Fine in the next couple of days. Very dry during the day. Very hot over parts of the territory with a rather large temperature difference between day and night. Sunny periods early next week.
